recommendations.action: Implement T-R012-CI-001 submodule pointer guard in .github/workflows/ci.yml and release.yml
recommendations.details: Add a step early in each workflow that runs `git -C Hexalith.EventStore rev-parse HEAD` and asserts the result matches a checked-in expected commit (e.g., from a `.eventstore-pinned-commit` file or env var). Fail the build on drift with a diff in the log.

Mirror the TenantIndex_RetryExhaustion sentinel pattern (lines 167-232) but target the audit-key exhaustion path. Use sentinel values for audit narrative payload + user identifiers; assert they do not appear in Logger.Entries[i].Message or .StateText.

Trigger mid-flow cancellation against a tenant audit query, assert OperationCanceledException is thrown and that any captured log entries do NOT contain sentinel tenant name / user identifier / cursor payload.

recommendations.action: Cross-check that EventStore Server.Tests carries R-006 cache-coherence tests for CachingProjectionActor
recommendations.details: Open EventStore submodule, grep for cache-coherence-after-conflict tests, confirm at least one test asserts that post-conflict retry causes the actor to return persisted state (not stale cached snapshot). If absent, escalate to EventStore-side follow-up story.
